name: return27-foreign-tax-credit
description: Form 1116 (passive category): a US person sells inherited/owned real property in India. Gain is FOREIGN-SOURCE (income from real property is sourced where the property sits — §862(a)(5)), so the Indian tax withheld at source (TDS u/s 195) is creditable — but only up to the US tax on that same income (§904). Wages 100,000 + foreign long-term capital gain 50,000; Indian tax paid 10,000; federal withholding 15,000.
note: HAND-VERIFIED against the PLACEHOLDER fixture rule-data this golden runs on (single std deduction 15,000; ordinary brackets 10/12/22% at 10k/40k/90k; LTCG 0% to 48k then 15%). Taxable = 100,000 + 50,000 - 15,000 = 135,000. Ordinary portion = 135,000 - 50,000 pref = 85,000 -> 10,000x.10 = 1,000 + 30,000x.12 = 3,600 + 45,000x.22 = 9,900 = 14,500. The 50,000 LTCG stacks above ordinary 85,000, past the 0% ceiling (48,000), so all of it sits in the 15% band = 7,500. Total tax 22,000. SS904(b)(2)(B): the entire foreign-source amount is long-term gain taxed at the 15% marginal preferential rate, so it is scaled 15/37 -> 50,000 x 15 / 37 = 20,270.27 -> 20,270. Limitation = 22,000 x 20,270 / 135,000 = 3,303.26 -> 3,303. Credit = min(10,000 Indian tax paid, 3,303 limitation) = 3,303 -- the taxpayer cannot credit more than the US tax on that same income. Unused 6,697 carries (SS904(c), informational here). Tax after credits = 22,000 - 3,303 = 18,697; payments 15,000 -> 3,697 owed. §904(b)(2)(B)(ii) CORRECTION: the rate-differential adjustment applies to ENTIRE taxable income (Form 1116 line 18) as well as to foreign-source income, and the kernel previously scaled only the numerator. HAND-VERIFIED on return27: adjusted foreign-source = 50,000 x 15/37 = 20,270; the reduction to worldwide = 50,000 - 20,270 = 29,730, so line 18 = 135,000 - 29,730 = 105,270; limitation = 22,000 x 20,270/105,270 = 4,236 (was 3,303 on the unadjusted 135,000). Independently confirmed against a professionally prepared return whose Form 1116 line 18 was 239,975 against taxable income of 295,678 - a reduction of exactly (net capital gain + qualified dividends) x (1 - 15/37). The credit rises in every affected golden and stays at or below foreign tax paid.
